Our Story

Where Beauty Meets Luxury

LEEPRIME BEAUTY SALON is a premium beauty destination in Midrand offering exceptional nail, lash, and beauty services in a clean, stylish, and welcoming environment.

We are passionate about helping every client feel confident, beautiful, and cared for. From the moment you walk through our doors, you are treated like royalty — because you are.

Walk-ins are always welcome, but we strongly recommend booking in advance to secure your preferred time slot, especially on weekends when we tend to get busy.
With proper care, acrylic nails typically last 2–3 weeks before needing a fill. Gel nails can last 2–4 weeks. We recommend a fill or maintenance appointment every 2–3 weeks.
Absolutely. We use only premium, professional-grade products and follow strict sterilization and hygiene protocols for all tools and equipment. Your safety is our top priority.
We accept cash, card payments (Visa & Mastercard), and EFT. Payment is due at time of service. For larger pamper packages, a small deposit may be required to secure your booking.
Yes! We love bridal parties, baby showers, and girls' days out. Contact us directly to arrange a group booking or special pamper event at our salon.
Avoid oil-based products near your lashes, don't rub your eyes, and sleep on a silk pillowcase. Come in for fills every 2–3 weeks to keep your lashes looking full and flawless.
